steps.what: Read actual process requirements, site dimensions and equipment constraints
Choose equipment arrangement, access, process connections and maintenance clearances
Draw the selected equipment layout and associated labels in plant CAD
Check complete final layout against actual process, safety and access constraints
Save the checked final equipment layout

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} plant-CAD equipment objects, linked labels and reusable drawing views. Engineer chooses the actual arrangement and checks final safety and access; repeated drafting reduces without automatic process design.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment objects and linked annotations.
tasks.still_hard: Safe, maintainable placement within actual process constraints.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve layout trade-offs and recognise operational hazards.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive drafting; layout responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native plant-CAD objects and linked labels reduce drafting repetition without selecting a safe equipment layout.

assumptions: Boundary is equipment layout through design save, not construction release. Process owner supplies actual requirements; site owner actual dimensions; equipment suppliers actual dimensions and connection data. Engineer verifies in s1, selects placement in s2 and enters actual objects in s3; missing geometry is manually drawn and checked. No free digitised plant model.

Native first; existing configured objects yield zero saving. Provisional drawing40 includes actual placement entry, only repetition reduces. Final layout QA4 is provisional and must be measured for actual complexity; no review time removed. Constraints15, design40 and save1 unchanged; shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Actual CAD object support and drawing/review effort
research_questions: Which repeated labels and objects can native configuration handle without hiding design constraints?

tasks.short: Prepare production cost estimates and progress reports.

steps.what: Reconcile actual production quantities, rates, costs and progress records
Select estimate assumptions and assess actual production progress and causes
outputs: engineer selected assumptions and progress interpretation

steps.what: Populate production cost estimate calculations from selected quantities and rates
inputs: engineer selected assumptions and progress interpretation

steps.what: Populate production progress tables and charts from actual status records
Write management report explanations for actual estimates and progress
inputs: engineer selected assumptions and progress interpretation

loop.input: checked source records, draft estimate and engineer interpretations
loop.output: draft management narrative with actual figures and qualifications
loop.check: Engineer checks cost scope, progress meaning, causal claims, forecast versus actual and omitted exceptions against evidence
loop.stop: Unsupported cause, missing source or two failed revisions requires manual report writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native tables first; variable production explanations need bounded prose

steps.what: Check the complete final cost estimate, progress report and management recipients
outputs: checked final estimate and report with recipients

steps.what: Save the final estimate and progress report
inputs: checked final estimate and report with recipients

steps.what: Send the final estimate and report to designated managers
inputs: checked final estimate and report with recipients

tasks.design: Configure native {ERP}/{OPS_SYSTEM} exports, {SPREADSHEET} estimate fields and {BI} progress tables. Use a bounded loop only for the engineer-selected management explanation; check the complete final report before separate save and internal send.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated production data transfer, estimate population and report composition.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and linked report fields with bounded explanatory drafting.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing credible assumptions and explaining actual production deviations.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish actual results, forecasts and uncertain causes.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated reporting; estimate and production judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native production exports, estimate templates and linked report tables can reduce repeated report preparation without selecting estimate assumptions.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual production estimate and progress report preparation through internal delivery. Operations owner produces period, product, quantities, progress status and exceptions; finance owner rates, currency, date and cost scope. Engineer reconciles missing data in s1 and selects assumptions and causal explanations in s2. No free exception classifications or invented baseline costs.

Native first; configured formulas, dashboards and runtime earn zero new saving. Provisional s3 saving is human population, s4 human table transfer. Shares unmeasured and estimate/report mix illustrative. Normal final review9 retained, routine save1 and send1 retained. Draft review13.3 already counted, not deducted again.
unknowns: Actual estimate/report mix and source export coverage
research_questions: Which human transfers remain after current native reporting?

tasks.short: Test and monitor chemical production process variables.

steps.what: Perform actual process tests and observe temperature, density, specific gravity and pressure
Transfer actual process-instrument results into the monitoring dataset
Interpret actual variability and determine the degree of process control
Record and check actual test findings and process-control conclusions
Save the actual process test record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} process-instrument exports and mapped monitoring imports. Actual testing and interpretation remain human; automate repeated reading transfer only, without changing the plant control system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated transcription of actual process measurements.
tasks.enabler_now: Native instrument exports and mapped imports.
tasks.still_hard: Representative testing and diagnosing unstable process behaviour.
tasks.human_edge: Judge what actual variability means for control.
tasks.altitude: Less measurement transcription; process judgement unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native instrument imports reduce result transcription without performing physical tests or establishing process control.

assumptions: Boundary is actual tests and own monitoring findings, not plant actuation. Engineer produces actual measurements in s1; instrument supplies sensor/sample ID, timestamp, variable, value, unit and calibration status. Engineer resolves missing fields manually in s2. Unsupported instruments use manual entry; no free measurements or compliance verdict.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native laboratory instrument imports reduce result transcription without designing experiments or discovering chemical processes.
